payload.text: (2026-10-24, hv's selections in the TUIs vc asked between vc's clock reads of 10:00Z and 12:20Z, and hv first-hand in vc's session; wording vc's, each choice hv's; vc's recommendation taken unless said) SEVEN RULINGS FOR THE 3.2.6 CUT AND 3.2.7. (1) Intent's dev/opt/brew conformance thread sits THIRD in 3.2.7, after 0635 and the devbin re-vendor, before WP-02's Intent half; the re-vendor takes devbin v0.1.14 (devbin decision 60: hv cuts 0.1.14 privately once 0213 lands; 0213 landed at 76b3d790), one re-vendor, not two. (2) kovacs stays brew-only; after a release reaches the tap, kovacs-sysadm runs brew upgrade intent on vc's notice in its own session, booked with molt-vc as a run (molt-vc, 12:4xZ). (3) Issue 0636, filed during the freeze, was committed before the tag with a fresh preflight. (4) ST0086 was committed and authored before the tag, hv first-hand: "There's no risk of adding docs. Just put it in now." (5) ST0086 has four WPs in one thread, hv first-hand: the record and its doors, intentd's /estate/status page, the TUI, and a generic slot protocol with lane types, lanes with a capacity and a controller any assigned session may hold, dedicated or a project node, running on Intent alone with no Molt (hv: "This is all inside Intent"). (6) The v3.2.6 tag's red CI is fixed on main and the tag stays; no re-cut. (7) Whether main is pushed to upstream after each landing, so CI judges each commit rather than each cut, is OPEN for hv; vc recommends it.
